author: FutbolHunter
body: So yesterday (July 11) I was banned by Tomqss for racism after a scrimmage we had against Xenarch. And I wanted to clear things up and explain why I should not be banned. First of all, if what I think I was banned for is correct then I was banned for saying "He is probably getting beat by his Muslim parents" to one of our own players. First off, the word Muslim doesn't apply to a race is applies to a religion, which can't be punished by "racism". And second off, the player I told that to was GeneralXRay and we have been playing with him for about 4 months. He is in fact Muslim, you can ask him, ask for picture or anything, and you can see for yourselves. My intentions were not to be racist I was just stating a fact.
